rationale: The assistant reached the correct diagnosis (failed fan oven element) after the customer's visual inspection, then got the model number and offered a matching part with an engineer as a fallback. Weaknesses: the early turns were weak, with a pointless 15-minute heat test the customer had already done and a terse reply that never said to isolate power first. The final message had a template glitch ('[object Object]'), and it never explicitly told the customer to keep the power isolated while fitting. The part was recommended only after visual confirmation and the model number, so it is justified.
